title: Isandro and the Debt
author: Odile Sterling
blurb: Felix Nystrom, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
